evidence:

	check(count_exact(term, rl.Color{168, 114, 80, 255}) > 12, "type chips: campus block+tower", count_exact(term, rl.Color{168, 114, 80, 255}))
	check(count_exact(term, rl.Color{70, 130, 180, 255}) > 8, "type chips: host play-mark", count_exact(term, rl.Color{70, 130, 180, 255}))
detail: Chip pins assert presence on the healthy terminal_types golden only; nothing asserts chips are suppressed when a health ring is up (D5), so a chip_visible regression under congestion is only caught by whole-image re-bless diffs.
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck pin on a health-state golden (e.g. node_health) asserting chip-glyph pixels absent in the ringed node's chip band.
